limitations: Computed DOM visibility uses styles, rectangular clipping and native hit-testing of opaque backgrounds, not OCR of encoded pixels.
Animated glyph children, SVG masks, filters, nonrectangular clipping and complex occlusion still require exported-MP4 frame review.
Finite narrative mentions and the final signature are allowed; only persistent small stationary labels are flagged.
No final visual-quality approval is inferred from this runtime audit.
